answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Proof, not promises: Maltster clear juniper warrant distilled at the still house asks for each clear juniper is a stilling record witnessed by the excise officer, and no farm can supply it honestly. One clone costs 80 POA and 11 minutes to raise; 403 clones cost 32240 POA and 4433 minutes each epoch to keep. The mirror opens the gate, the trellis pays the toll, the prism proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
